settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How the agent runs.
settings.modelHelp: Which model answers. Loaded models respond fastest.
settings.modelUnavailable: The model endpoint is unreachable, so there is nothing to choose from.
settings.effortHelp: How long the agent may think and how many tool steps it may take.
settings.effortMinimalHelp: Least thinking, at most 2 tool steps. Best for quick questions.
settings.effortLowHelp: Short thinking, up to 4 tool steps.
settings.effortMediumHelp: Fuller thinking, up to 8 tool steps.
settings.effortHighHelp: Longest thinking and the full tool budget. Slowest.
